_comment: Ground truth from the Scala reference stack (sigma-state 6.0.2 + ergo-core 6.0.2).
Pins the fourth EvaluatedValue subclass -- GroupGenerator, sigma/ast/values.scala:709 --
appearing as a stored VALUE in a box register and in a ContextExtension entry.
ValueSerializer writes it as its bare one-byte opcode 0x82, not as the 34-byte
SGroupElement Constant form, and a box id is blake2b256 of the box bytes, so the
one-byte form is consensus-committed. Its value is CryptoConstants.dlogGroup.generator,
and the JVM reduces it identically to a group-element constant of that point.

box_candidate._comment: ErgoBoxCandidate: 1000000 nanoERG, script sigmaProp(true), height 0, R4 = GroupGenerator

ergo_box._comment: The same candidate as output index 3 of transaction 0x07..07; id = blake2b256(box bytes)

transaction._comment: 1-in/1-out tx whose input extension binds var 1 to the GroupGenerator node

_comment: CErgoTreeEvaluator.eval against the dummy ErgoLikeContext (activated version 3,
self box = the tree at 1000000 nanoERG, sole input). P:d3 = TrivialProp(true).

register_equals_generator_constant_contr._comment: Same script, R4 = GroupElementConstant(generator). Identical verdict AND cost -- the node and the constant are value-equivalent; only the bytes differ.
